ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; >98% low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with minimal high-intensity pixels concentrated on peripheral barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white contiguous blobs mapped to distal lobe tips and along the upper-right trailing margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence point; vertical indentation depth is approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the outer thirds of the trailing edge, showing sharp peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge boundary, curving from the lateral terminals toward the central vertical axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels in irregular circular formations at the extreme left and right distal margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Peripheral barnacle colonization visible as protruding white calcified structures along the outer trailing margins of both fluke lobes.
